# Solver CLI — Command Reference

Complete, always-current reference for every `node scripts/solve.js`
subcommand. Ground truth is the dispatch map in
[`scripts/solve.js`](../../../scripts/solve.js); descriptions live in the
curated sidecar [`../solve-commands.json`](../solve-commands.json). See
[`boot.md`](boot.md) for first commands and [`core.md`](core.md) for the
guardrail command map.

| Command | Purpose | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | Seal a quest: validate solve/quests/<id>/quest.json and its epic, measure the doneWhen probe, refuse unless the probe is red, then record sealedAt (HEAD) and the seal-time metric in the log. | `node scripts/solve.js start --id <quest> [--json]` |
| `note` | Append one log entry: a finding (kinds theory, altitude-check, decision, ruled-out, evidence), an attempt (records HEAD and the changed paths), a verification (verifier subagent:<id>, verdict approve|reject), or a terminal entry other than solved (blocked with a next owner, exhausted, superseded). | `node scripts/solve.js note --id <quest> (--finding "<text>" [--kind <kind>] [--status <status>] [--evidence <ref>] | --attempt "<what changed>" | --verification "<summary>" --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve|reject | --blocked "<why>" --next-owner judgment|verification|authorization | --exhausted "<why>" | --superseded "<why>" [--by <quest>]) [--json]` |
| `probe` | Measure a quest's doneWhen (or an epic's with --epic): metric, target, done, whether it measured, the delta from the seal-time value, and the last three log entries. | `node scripts/solve.js probe --id <quest> | --epic <epic> [--json]` |
| `land` | Land a sealed quest: the probe must be green; a standing rejection blocks; src/ changes need a current approving verification; the altitude budget, the epic's authorizes scope, the coupled-pair guard and the changed-path static checkers must pass; then the inventories refresh, the canonical import graph verifies, npm test runs, the change commits with LAGRANGE_SOLVER_LANDING=1, and a terminal solved entry is written. Never pushes. | `node scripts/solve.js land --id <quest> [--json]` |
| `evidence` | Upload a file to the solve-evidence pre-release, verify it by re-download and re-hash, and record an evidence finding with the sha256 reference and URL; nothing is recorded on a mismatch. | `node scripts/solve.js evidence add <file> --id <quest> [--text "<why>"] [--json]` |
| `board` | Print the open epics and open quests computed from solve/epics and solve/quests on demand; nothing is written. | `node scripts/solve.js board [--json]` |
